fusions.name: Bowled Over
fusions.desc: You crash into everything close, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Big Game Brought Low
fusions.desc: A full-weight blow that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Full Weight Forward
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds. A packmate fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Level Ground
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
